Title: AKU-IED to work with ESRA for capacity building of selected districts of Sindh and Balochistan
NewsSummary: Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED) has agreed to work as a national partner with Research Triangle Institute- Education Sector Reform Assistance (RTI-ESRA) for building institutional capacity of the selected districts
NewsContent:
​Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED) has agreed to work as a national partner with Research Triangle Institute- Education Sector Reform Assistance (RTI-ESRA) for building institutional capacity of the selected districts of Sindh and Balochistan. These initiatives are being funded by USAID.

An orientation programme about AKU-IED's role in building the institutional capacity was arranged at AKU-IED, Karimabad. The programme was attended by Dr. Noor-ul-Haq, Additional Secretary (Academic), Department of Education and Literacy, Government of Sindh; Dr. Mehboob Ali Sheikh, Director General Provincial Institute for Teacher Education; Executive District Officers (Education); and District Officer (Education) of District Thatta, Hyderabad, Khairpur, and Sukkur.

The representatives from the four districts shared their planned initiatives for improving the quality of elementary education. In his welcome address, Dr. Sadrudin Pardhan, Acting Director AKU-IED welcomed the participants and apprised them about the role of AKU-IED in quality improvement through research, professional development programmes, and policy dialogues.  Dr. Noor-ul-Haq, speaking on this occasion, said it was right time for  the provincial and district governments for improving the quality of education in the country through AKU-IED's innovative professional development programmes for teachers and educational officers. Fawad Shams, Teacher Education-Component Leader-ESRA, shared the vision and initiatives taken by ESRA. He said that these initiatives would help develop teachers and others to become effective practitioners. He added that ESRA plans would support the existing infrastructure including PITE for its capacity building.

Dr. Muhammad Memon, Head of Programmes, AKU-IED, shared with the officers the Institute's plans and strategies for institutional capacity building of the selected districts of Sindh and Balochistan.
